# 08 - Limitations

What this phase cannot tell you, stated plainly so that nobody has to
rediscover it later.

## The big one

**Zero interviews. Zero buyer conversations. Zero respondent quotes.**

Every cell is documentary - a registered source states it, or it is arithmetic
on registered sources - or it is graded INFERRED with the inference chain
named, or it is UNKNOWN. There is no fifth category where something
plausible was written down as if it were known. That is why two whole stages
(S08 Market Validation, S10 Growth) ship as twelve UNKNOWN cells rather than
a plausible narrative.

**This phase therefore describes a journey that institutions are required to
walk, not a journey they actually walk.** The mandated stages are documented.
The actual sequence - who does what, in what order, with what tool - is only
partially documented, and the gap between the two is exactly where a product
wins or loses.

## Specific limits

| | Limit | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Internal tooling is UNKNOWN at every stage** (P-A10) | We can name the mandated tools; we cannot name the ones actually used between them |
| 2 | **Hours are not measured** (P-A10:554) | MW-08 unknown; every productivity claim is unquantified |
| 3 | **Rupees are not priced** | MW-09 unknown; OQ-03 (willingness to pay) stays open |
| 4 | **Two stages have zero registered sources** | S08 and S10 are maps of questions, not answers |
| 5 | **Public IIC detail is login-gated** | Some portal detail is second-hand through official documents, not direct observation |
| 6 | **No Emerging-tier State Startup Ranking report** | State-level comparison is incomplete |
| 7 | **G2 blocks automation** | No bulk extraction of the public NIRF startup dataset at scale |
| 8 | **GAP-06/09/11 have no Phase 10 matrix dimension** | D3, D4 and D6 "0 holders" claims are asserted, not measured |
| 9 | **No primary research with any buyer** | Demand-side evidence is absent by construction |
| 10 | **Single-country scope** | Every source is Indian; the constraints are Indian constraints |

## What would change these limits

| | Instrument | Limits it removes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Phase 3B interview instrument | 1, 2, 3, 4, 9 |
| 2 | Vendor interviews | 9, and the demand side of D4 |
| 3 | Phase 10 matrix dimensions for GAP-06/09/11 | 8 |
| 4 | Logged-in portal access | 5, 6, 7 |

## What this phase does establish

It is worth being clear about this too, because a phase that only lists
limitations is indistinguishable from a phase that failed.

- **The 11-stage shape** of the mandated journey, with a documentary basis
  for each stage.
- **The single documentary join** between the venture track and the data
  track, and its three limiting properties (one-directional, ARIIA-scoped,
  NIRF-I not removed).
- **14 breakpoints**, of which 8 are severity-3 hard gates or
  data-integrity failures, each citing registered sources.
- **7 structural counts** - 128+ artefacts a year,
  ~11 screens per discipline, 7 hand-typed fields per startup, 4 reporting
  systems, 12 council roles.
- **45 of 66 cells** graded documentary, with a
  per-cell source list that an audit can re-verify independently.

That is a real map of the mandated world. It is not a map of the buyer.
